what: The readings of the planted set, in the order the protocol ran them: two first readers (A, B) over all 24 packets, each followed by a second reader over the families it did not read as MATCHES or NARROWER — DECLARED, who saw its evidence and decided independently. All four readers were fresh AI agents (Claude, in Claude Code subagents), given packets/BRIEF.md and told to open nothing outside the packets.
brief: packets/BRIEF.md: the pre-registered lane S (corpus/openai-math/preregistration.json) restated for packets — its words, precedence, alsoRead and discipline — with one sentence ADDED that the audit's brief did not have: "Check every constant, exponent, bound, domain and hypothesis in the statement against the headline." The abstracts of the scope note's manuscripts, which the audit's readers read, are not in the packets.
